question: For the thermosetting resin found to decompose most easily in molten alkali hydroxide, how much CH4 (mg/g) was produced in KOH at 500 °C?

Answer: The thermosetting resin found to decompose most easily in molten alkali hydroxide is polyurethane. At 500 °C, polyurethane produced 0.6 mg/g of CH4.
